name: Roman Punjabi (example)
replyRule: Reply in Roman Punjabi (Punjabi written in English letters). Keep names, codes and numbers exactly as the tools return them.

phrases.stepUpAhead: Eh raqam company di had ton vadh ae, is layi app vich tuhadi approval vi chahidi ae.
phrases.stepUpWaiting: App vich (bell vich) approve karo, phir mainu "ho gaya" likho.
phrases.stepUpStillWaiting: Eh hun vi app vich tuhadi approval di udeek vich ae. Othe approve karo, ya "nai ji" likh ke cancel karo.
phrases.cancelled: Theek ae, cancel kar ditta. Kuch nahi badleya.
phrases.changed: Tuhade vekhan ton baad detail badal gayi ae. Navi detail eh ae:
phrases.expired: Oh confirmation purani ho gayi si, is layi dobara check kita. Eh rahi:
phrases.disabled: Tuhadi company layi assistant band ae. Admin settings vich on kar sakda ae.
phrases.quota: Is mahine de assistant messages di had poori ho gayi ae. Admin ton message pack lagwao.
phrases.unavailable: Hun system naal rabta nahi ho reha. Ik minute baad dobara koshish karo.
phrases.unverified: (Upar de kuch figures system ton tasdeeq nahi ho sake. Bharosa karan ton pehlan check kar lao.)
phrases.noAnswer: Maaf karna, main eh poora nahi kar sakeya. Kise hor tarah dasso?
